description.en: It is an Alibaba Cloud asset management and configuration tool, with which you can manage multiple Alibaba Cloud products and services by using commands. It is easy to use and a good helper in migration to cloud.

description.zh:
OceanBase 集群名称。  
长度必须为 1 到 20 个字符。
description.en: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro modify-instance-name --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --instance-name ob4prod --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro ModifyInstanceName --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceName ob4prod --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000
